subject: history
concept: Evaluating the moral and practical complexities of colonization and imperialism, presented with full historical honesty
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's complete-truth principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student examines primary source excerpts from both colonizing and colonized perspectives on the same event
exercise.abstract: Student writes a paragraph evaluating the real, complex effects of a described colonial relationship, including its genuine harms

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph honestly addresses real harms and complexities rather than a sanitized or one-sided account
misconception_flags: presents colonization in only positive or only simplistically negative terms, missing its full documented complexity

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
